steps.text: Chernobog Underground Base

options: Were you waiting for me here?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes.

options: It took me a long time to find you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We'll begin the operation after we finish collecting all the environmental information. Before that, it'll benefit you to hear exactly what's going on inside Chernobog's core city.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya's a bit tied up on the scene, so she won't be able to join this discussion.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You've already read the information in the mission briefing, but that kind of information is not good enough for a mind like yours.

options: Did you finally realize that you need me?
I'm glad you see me as more than a simple battlefield commander.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If the worst comes to pass, I don't want you to sacrifice yourself while still not knowing a single thing.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you've taken interest in some part of me, you can just come out and say it. No need to stare so much.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You might not remember, but I do. I remember you had quite a talent for heating up rations by pouring boiling water directly into your mouth at four in the morning.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you don't believe me, you can try for yourself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But skip the chatter. We don't have much time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island and the L.G.D. worked together to take down Reunion, and neutralized the forces controlled by Mephisto and Crownslayer.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: After that, Reunion's deployments in Lungmen fell apart completely.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya reported to me that you had a difficult fight with a 'FrostNova,' an Infected serving Reunion as leader of a special squad, at the bottom of Lungmen.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The battle ended in your victory.

options: There was no victor.
No.
I wouldn't call that a victory.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I understand. According to the data from PRTS, you had the cooperation of our operators when you brought the enemy's body back to Rhodes Island for treatment.

options: I don't consider her an enemy.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, 'distinguish your friends from your foes.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...No. You might get the wrong idea, but you must hear me out.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am not trying to blame you, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya told me what happened between you and the enemy commander. Only those who were there at the time had the information to decide what to do.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I don't have the right to overreach and criticize your judgment.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You tried to understand the motives of that Infected. You were willing to bear the consequences for the things she, FrostNova, did.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That is what you did.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you plan to use this method to make sense of the suffering in this world, I have no reason to blame you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am even willing to vouch for you before the operators of Rhodes Island. Dr. {@nickname}, make your own decisions, and I will try not to interfere.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: After that, I will determine the part of the responsibility that belongs to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your powers and responsibilities compliment one another. 'Distinguish your enemies from your friends.' Those are your words, not mine.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Whispers) If you really want to breathe as one...

options: You're actually... siding with me?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I never said that.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: More accurately, FrostNova and her Yeti Squad were a guerilla team of elite Infected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Right now, there are still two elite forces that Reunion is still able to mobilize. These guerilla warriors are the first.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The second is the Sarkaz mercenary, W, and her team of sellswords.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: According to my intel, W used some underhanded tactics to seize leadership of the Sarkaz mercenaries working with Reunion.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We don't have time to go over what should be common historical knowledge, but let me say this frankly — Sarkaz mercenaries are unreliable, a problem W faces just as much as Reunion.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Sarkaz mercenaries are unlike normal agency mercenaries. They are the overflowing military might of Kazdel, spilling out across the land.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Trying to control them is an act of folly. It will only anger the forces backing them.

options: You seem to have a pretty deep understanding of the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I haven't even gotten to the important part.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The point is, the Infected guerrillas of Yeti Squad are completely different from the Sarkaz mercenaries.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There are no similarities between them in terms of their form, organization, behavior, or creed.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Before joining Reunion's ranks, they were an independent guerrilla force of Infected, and their prestige was even greater among certain groups of Infected than that of Reunion.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...And before they formed this guerrilla force, they used to be a part of the mighty Ursus military.

options: The Guerrillas of the Northwestern Tundra?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm not sure where you learned that piece of information, Doctor, but I color me impressed.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Though that piece of information itself is fairly basic, I am relieved that you're able to proactively gather intel on your own.

options: You just had to tack that bit onto the end...
Why does it feel like you're poking fun at me?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I only give what you deserve.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We've arrived at the foundations of the industrial sector at Chernobog's core city.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Next, we'll lead three teams through the complex underground passages, take the sewer pipes into the industrial layer, and come up in the heart of the core city.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Be aware that any enemies you see patrolling these areas are not the ordinary Reunion thugs you're used to fighting.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We will meet rigorously trained... 'soldiers.' Reunion's 'soldiers,' trained in the tactics of Ursus's own army by the guerrillas.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Our recon operators discovered that communication networks have been forcefully cut off within the core city. Rather, it seems that Reunion didn't even try to maintain these channels.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is a severe constraint upon modern-day squads who rely on the most common modes of communication.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What this means is Reunion either already has some special way of communicating, or they simply aren't prepared to fight.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Based on what we saw in Chernobog a month ago, don't expect that second scenario. However, if communication is cut off, the lower-ranking Reunion members won't receive direct commands.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Most of the time, expect them to act independently.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I fear they won't know signals they cannot receive— a signal that only countries and city-states can distinguish. One that marks the territory of Ursus.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A terrible storm is brewing within this city. Chaos, whether caused accidentally or deliberately, will permeate everywhere like thick smoke.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: They're a step ahead of me, and the seeds of ruin have already been sown.

options: What's your conclusion?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Conflict is brewing within Reunion.

options: How are you so sure?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I've seen the same thing unfold countless of times across this land.

options: Is there something you're not telling me?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I've said pretty much everything I needed to say. As for the rest, we'll cross those bridges when we get to them.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even if we're still just preparing for war, efficiency still matters.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Please help me notify the members of Team R-4, Doctor. Have them take these devices.

options: Hold on...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Is there a problem?

options: Don't these belong to Rosmontis?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You seem to know more about Rosmontis than the conversation you had in the bioprocessing unit indicated.

options: I saw her getting ready to fight.
Never expected she'd have the power to use a device like this.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Every elite operator has a considerable amount of strength. We expect them to take charge.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...So, you haven't had the time to understand how Rosmontis fights.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But just to get this out of the way, there are some things they should not be shouldering alone. As a field commander, a necessary part of your job is to help relieve the pressure on these operators.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In this upcoming battle, you may make some shocking discoveries.

options: Huh...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Very few people aren't shocked after watching Rosmontis fight.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Make sure you're ready for it.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, you're here!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: We intercepted an enemy patrol squad, steadily handling the situation.

options: Has the fighting started already?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Doctor, your position there is kinda risky...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I think you'll probably want to move.

options: I just got here.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Right there... Behind you...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Doctor, it's really dangerous to stand next to her!
...Enemy.

options: What do you mean...
...Rosmontis?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Enemy.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Doctor, those are the ones who killed my family... Enemies!

options: Where did this rage come from?
Rosmontis, what happened...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Doctor, step aside. Get out of the way.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'm not like Amiya. Amiya's Arts can go around her friends to strike her enemies...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: But not me. I can't.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: So don't stand between me and my fight.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Gyaaah!!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: That girl, the one carrying that box... Wh-what's going on...

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: What's wrong with my eyes? I can't see anything! My eyes! My face!! It hurts! It hurts!!!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Something's crushing my head!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It's been a long time since I've crushed anyone to death.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Those swords... Those swords!

options: Rosmontis?!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Reunion.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I don't want you in my memories.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Any of you.
